charge_description: Summary conviction of William Holdsworth driver and waggoner of the common carrier waggon from Whitby to the city of York for purchasing nine pheasants from John Nicholson
raw_record: Summary conviction of William Holdsworth driver and waggoner of the common carrier waggon from Whitby to the city of York for purchasing nine pheasants from John Nicholson; on the information of John Steel of Winteringham servant to George Strickland esquire, and witnessed by John NicholsonOffence committed at the parish of St Michael in New Malton on 21 January 1818
